After that I ran off to the landlord and told him that some crazy lady is scratching walls with a knife. 
He immediately called for the police and they got her. This time they sadly haven’t started shooting. 
Later I told the policeman what happened. Turned out she was already suspected of killing a few guys. 
She will never bother me again. 
At least I hope so. 
I was afraid that I would get in trouble because of my sexbot, but…
… When the police came to my apartment the only thing they saw was a trashed plastic shell and some wires…
She was completely destroyed…
Well, I didn’t get in trouble after all. 
I don’t know how, but my mom heard about everything and came a few days later. 
My bullshit about my new job and me doing fine didn’t last long. She urged me to go back to her place and I had no choice, but to obey. 
Now…
Now I’m going to a low wage job back in my hometown. 
Mom is urging me to ask out this single mom next door. She isn’t my type, but… She’s nice to me{{wi}}, I guess.
I know nothing about children and I don’t like the idea of taking care of someone else’s kid, but mom told me it’s not a big deal and real catholic wouldn't think like that.
Well… I don’t know what the future holds for me, but things are not looking so bad.
So, yeah…
This story ends here...
